description:
List tags from a CKAN server using faceting.

This returns tag names with counts, optionally filtered by dataset query or tag substring.

Args:
  - server_url (string): Base URL of CKAN server
  - q (string): Dataset search query (default: "*:*")
  - fq (string): Filter query (optional)
  - tag_query (string): Filter tags by substring (optional)
  - limit (number): Max tags to return (default: 100, max: 1000)
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): Output format

Returns:
  List of tags with counts (from faceting)

Typical workflow: ckan_tag_list → ckan_package_search with fq="tags:tag_name" (find datasets by tag) → ckan_package_show

fq.description: Filter query in Solr syntax (e.g., 'organization:comune-palermo') to restrict which datasets contribute to tag counts

limit.description: Max tags to return (default 100, max 1000); tags are sorted by count descending

q.description: Dataset search query in Solr syntax to scope the tag facet (default: '*:*' for all datasets)

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for machine-readable

server_url.description: Base URL of the CKAN server (e.g., https://dati.gov.it/opendata)

tag_query.description: Substring filter applied to tag names after faceting (e.g., 'acqua' to keep only tags containing 'acqua')

name: ckan_tag_list
title: List CKAN Tags
